text: Robinhood Markets, Inc. is founder-controlled through super-voting Class B shares: per its 2026 proxy statement, co-founders Vladimir Tenev and Baiju Bhatt hold 26.1% and 32.0% of total voting power respectively (58.1% combined). Among Class A shareholders, The Vanguard Group (11.9%) and BlackRock (7.0%) are also disclosed 5%+ holders.
